bullets.text: US Firms Sue Ofcom - US companies challenge UK regulator's enforcement of the Online Safety Act, citing free speech violations.
AI Pilot Success Rates - Only 5% of generative AI pilots succeed, highlighting the need for strategic implementation.
AI Chip Market Growth - Omdia forecasts AI chip market to reach $286 billion by 2030, despite slowing growth rates.
Nvidia Eyes China Market - Nvidia's CEO hints at potential sales of Blackwell AI chips in China, pending regulatory approval.
Edge Computing Challenges - Telecom operators must address thermal efficiency to support AI at the edge effectively.
Data Center Workforce Crunch - Skilled labor shortages hinder rapid data center construction amid soaring demand.
China's Satellite Internet Push - China accelerates development of low-orbit satellite internet to compete with **Starlink**.
AI's Impact on Banking - AI tools reshape banking operations, but workforce displacement raises concerns about job security.
South Africa's Fiber Consolidation - Efforts underway to unify state-owned fiber networks for improved connectivity.
SK Telecom Fined $97M - South Korea imposes record fine on SK Telecom for major data breach and security lapses.
